\begin{defn} Let $I$ be an open interval.
A smooth curve $\gamma\colon I \rightarrow M$ is called a
\textit{geodesic}\index{geodesic} if $\nabla_{\dot \gamma}\dot
\gamma =0$.
\end{defn}

source.title: Ricci Flow and the Poincare Conjecture

scope: Geodesics as smooth curves on an open interval with vanishing covariant acceleration.
